contributions.detail: The 12 Schedule A rows sum to 712.25 + 55.00 + 237.38 + 275.00 + 402.00 + 475.00 + 28.47 + 148.00 + 1500.00 + 219.34 + 144.68 + 33.45 = 4230.57 exactly — equal to the page subtotal, the schedule's grand total, and the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B. Box C (Year to Date) also prints 4230.57 and is NOT summed as an increment. 12 of the grid's 15 printed rows are used; rows 13-15 are empty (crop-proved).

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (4230.57) on the p4 Summary Page — equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4230.57) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made' (4230.57)
expenditures.detail: The 12 Schedule B rows as PRINTED sum to 712.25 + 55.00 + 237.38 + 275.00 + 402.00 + 475.00 + 28.47 + 148.00 + 1500.00 + 219.34 + 114.68 + 33.45 = 4200.57, exactly 30.00 short of the schedule's own printed subtotal 4230.57, of its printed total, and of Box D. TRACED and UNIQUELY attributable from this page alone: the printed subtotal minus the other eleven rows leaves exactly 144.68 for row 11, whose cell prints 114.68 (escalated to 900 dpi: clean machine type, unambiguous). The row publishes 114.68 VERBATIM with needs_review=1; nothing was nudged and no printed total was touched. MISSED-ROW SCREEN RUN FIRST (H3/F1.5): band 13 one past the last transcribed row rendered an EMPTY boxed cell, the 15 bands run at a regular ~4.36 pitch with no ~2x doubled band, and the area below the grid carries only the printed Name-of-Candidate box and the Subtotal label — no missing row, no doubled band. CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN: this same filer's other published 2024 document (key 689f5ea9, the Seven-days-preceding-General report) carries the IDENTICAL 30.00 shortfall from the IDENTICAL cell — i.e. the slip is CORRELATED across the filer's two reports, which is what a single keying error copied forward into a restated ledger looks like, and is further evidence it is the filer's arithmetic rather than a mis-read. The cross-schedule figure (Schedule A row 11 prints 144.68 and closes that side exactly) EXPLAINS the delta but was NOT used to overwrite the cell (C3/M4).

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — the v. 12.23 Schedule A on this filing carries four columns (Date / Name of Contributor / Address and Zip Code / Amount) with NO in-kind checkbox and no in-kind line, and no row on either schedule is annotated in-kind. Both conventions were tested on both sides and are numerically identical here (no in-kind rows exist to add); monetary-only closes Schedule A exactly at 4230.57. The convention was determined FOR THIS FILING and not carried over from the filer's other 2024 document.

itemized.notes: modern_boxAF, form revision v. 12.23, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' (LAST — located by its heading, not by ordinal). NO CHECKLIST bound. pdfinfo: 4 pages, all rot: 0. Page-face candidate 'Andrea Allen'; page-face Office box 'Utah County Recorder' (index.csv 'County Recorder' agrees). THE DUPLICATE-CLUSTER VERDICT — THIS IS KIND (4), A DIFFERENT REPORT ENTIRELY, not a duplicate, not an amendment, not a second redaction pass. Evidence, all from the two page faces: (a) the report-type radio ticked here is '30 Days after the General Election' whereas 689f5ea9 ticks 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; (b) Date of Report is 12/05/2024 here, 10/29/2024 there, and each of the four pages carries its own Date-of-Report box repeating its own date; (c) the clerk's RECEIVED stamp reads DEC 05 2024 here (stamped inside the Office-Use box) and OCT 29 2024 there (stamped across the report-type block) — two separate filing events; (d) the amendment question is ticked NO on BOTH, so neither claims to amend the other; (e) the two documents are physically different scans, not the same bytes: here the form-field text renders in BLUE, the report-type X and both Date boxes are HANDWRITTEN in ink, and the page skew is -0.6/-0.7 deg, while 689f5ea9 is wholly typed in black at -0.2/-0.3 deg. WHAT THE ROW-BY-ROW COMPARISON FOUND: the two reports' ledgers are IDENTICAL entry for entry — same 12 contribution rows and same 12 expenditure rows, same dates (including the '03/07/024' three-digit-year slip), same donor, same vendors, same purposes, same 24 amounts including the 144.68/114.68 split across the two schedules, and the same six printed totals. Nothing was disclosed in one that the other withholds. So the later report RESTATES the earlier ledger unchanged rather than reporting new activity, and its Box B/D per-period cells repeat 4230.57 — a filer practice recorded here as an observation and NOT adjudicated (nothing was netted, differenced or merged; the two records stand independently). INDEPENDENT AGREEMENT IS CORROBORATION: this transcription was taken from this document's own pages and agrees with 689f5ea9's on all 24 amounts and all six printed totals, which strengthens both readings. PRIVACY: the county blacked out the candidate's street address, phone number and signature on the cover and every donor street line on Schedule A; no street address or phone number is carried into any field or note.
